we introduce the deep copula information bottleneck, a novel deep latent variable model that learns a disentangled, sparse, and interpretable latent representation, and that our model achieves better performance on both artificial and real data than the deep information bottleneck and other deep generative models.

we propose a deep information bottleneck method that learns sparse latent representations and that it outperforms the original information bottleneck method in terms of disentanglement, sparsity and predictive power.
